lcc_original: 於是該隱從永恆主面前走開，去住在伊甸東邊挪得【4】之地。
notes: LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 (WH03068); both render יְהוָה
UNV compounds 的面 with prepositions into one phrase; LCC splits across 從…面前 — prepositional prefix markers WAH04480+WAH09001 attached to 從, lexical root WH06440 (פָּנֶה) attached to 面前
LCC reorders verb 走開 after the prepositional phrase (從永恆主面前走開) vs UNV placing 離開 before (離開耶和華的面); SNs follow semantic correspondence not surface position
Footnote marker 【4】 preserved in original position after 挪得<WH05113>
